# Coherence widget contract snapshot

Canonical owner: `ajmwagar/coherence`, commit `0cdb6ca`.
Source paths: `crates/coherence-widget-contract/Cargo.toml` and `src/lib.rs`.

These files are an unchanged source artifact so a standalone Unibus checkout
does not require a sibling repository. Update them together from a verified
Coherence revision, rather than changing the contract here. The shared contract
has no provider collection, discovery, credentials or control operations.
